## BaseEntityController.localPredictionCustomState property

Optional custom owner-only prediction state for custom motors.

**Signature:**

```typescript
localPredictionCustomState?: readonly number[];
```

## Remarks

When `localPredictionMode` is `'custom'`<!-- -->, this array is mirrored to the owning client and restored before rollback replay. Use it for small deterministic numeric state such as angular velocity, dash cooldown counters, grapple length, or custom grounded timers.

\*\*Category:\*\* Controllers
